title: Unit Event — Deeper and Deeper — Episode2 Admiration

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime agrees to participate in a workshop run by ArcLand. As Rui takes the directors' course, he is confronted with something he's never realized about himself before.

rows.Line: Orientation Venue

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: We've invited two guests for the directors' course. One of them happens to be in attendance right now.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Would you be kind enough to introduce yourself, Mr. Sakaki?

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Wait...
Sakaki? As in...?

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Director
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...
se_event_deeper_2025_001

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line:
Hello.
I believe I'm meeting most of you for the very first time.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line:
My name is Koryu Sakaki.
I'll be one of your teachers during this workshop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Koryu Sakaki...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I've seen him on TV before!
He's a really famous director, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, he is.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Koryu Sakaki... Becoming the youngest-ever recipient of the Jiro Kikukawa Award for Theatrical Performances made him a household name.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's renowned for his artistry, but he's also known throughout the entertainment industry for his movies and TV dramas...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, whenever something becomes the talk of the town, you can bet you'll find his name in the credits.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And he isn't just popular in Japan. He's famous all over the world. Some of the most storied theatres have asked him to produce shows for them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I remember reading a magazine article that called him “the busiest director in Japan”...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow. What kind of person do you think he is?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, based on his list of works, he seems like the artistic type with very particular preferences...

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: I'm really in no position to be teaching anyone anything...

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: But ArcLand has been so good to me, after all. I couldn't simply turn them down.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: In any case, if you find anything I say to be interesting, then I hope you're able to make use of it.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: So, let's all do our best together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's much more modest than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm a bit surprised...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Yes, he seems like an interesting fellow...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Each of Koryu Sakaki's shows is unique in its own way.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It can be the most absurd, impenetrable piece of theatre or a show that's all laughs... Everything that he makes possesses its own “flavor”.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He has an uncanny ability to bring a character's innermost thoughts, good and bad, to the surface, and present them in a fiercely captivating manner.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They definitely outdid themselves by bringing him here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(...?
That expression he just made...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, no. It's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He reminded me of someone else for a second there...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I might've just been imagining things.)

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Mr. Sakaki.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: Our second guest will be joining us remotely from abroad due to some scheduling issues.

rows.Speaker: Workshop Host
rows.Line: He's...
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wow, it sounds like this workshop is going to be incredible!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
Today was merely the orientation...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But the venues they've provided and the guests they've invited as teachers are top-class!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I still can't believe it. This workshop is like a hundred times grander than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You've looked dazed ever since they finished explaining everything to us, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, are you feeling alright?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm fine. I was just a bit overwhelmed...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But this is also an unbelievably valuable opportunity to learn from world-class professionals.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right.
We're sure to grow a tremendous amount, as long as we don't shy away from this challenge.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's give it everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're so motivated!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Is something wrong, Rui?
Are you feeling sleepy?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You've looked a little out of it for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, nothing's wrong.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's just... Somehow it hasn't entirely sunk in for me, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What hasn't sunk in?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ArcLand invited two guests to come and teach us during this workshop.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The first is Koryu Sakaki, one of Japan's most renowned directors. The second is...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <It doesn't matter if you're rich or poor, clever or foolish, among the majority or minority...>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <All people laugh, cry and feel anger in the same way...>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <That is what ties us all together after bearing witness to a truly marvelous spectacle.>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <My goal is to keep making shows that do just that.>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <I believe that is the key to humanity becoming one... I believe that there's something unimaginably special awaiting us at the end of that path!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tom Gray.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A director I admire very much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So Rui, you get to be taught by your hero?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, so it seems.
Perhaps that's why nothing has felt quite real all afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I understand exactly how you feel!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I thought I was dreaming when I heard that Mr. Amami had come to see our show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I remember.
It's difficult to believe that these things could actually happen.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I could somehow tell my younger self this would happen, I'm sure he wouldn't believe me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
This Mr. Gray really means a lot to you, doesn't he?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I wish I could tell little Rui the good news.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did you know? In the future, you'll work very, very hard...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And someday, you'll get to meet your hero! That's what I would say.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Opportunity has come knocking, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I understand what you're feeling, but you need to focus and make this most of this golden opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You've got this, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rui... I believe in you...♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That was pretty clear, for sleep talk.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
I plan on learning as much as I possibly can.
